label: Cropland (share of each ~1 km cell, Impact Observatory 10 m land cover)
source: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m Annual Land Use Land Cover (io-lulc-annual-v02) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
native_resolution: 10 m map, sampled at ~80 m, shown as class share per 0.01° (~1 km) cell
notes: Share (%) of the 10 m Impact Observatory land-cover map's crops class in each 0.01° (~1 km) cell, from the same 1-in-64 nearest-neighbour sample (~80 m) as the county series lulc_crop_pct (the county value is the sample-weighted mean of these cells; r > 0.9998). One map per year 2017-2023 (the latest published); later months show 2023. Map: continuous colour from the 2nd (red) to the 98th (green) percentile of all years; white = middle.
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); 2nd-98th percentile of all dates
smoothing: average of the grid cells in each display pixel
transparent: zero / none (and the colour scale starts at the lowest non-zero values)
